title: U.S. Designates Ecuador’s Los Tiguerones Gang as Terrorist Group
summary_full: The sanctions on Los Tiguerones imposed by Secretary of State Marco Rubio are an increasingly common U.S. tactic, though they will likely not hurt the gang’s finances.
